observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment capability-intelligence projection and session diagnostic evidence

outcome.limitation: At the baseline Environment commit, the capability-intelligence projection had no path from the session diagnostic_history or diagnostic_epoch fields to session_activity. The selected persistent session already contained one diagnostic summary and an immutable same-session evidence reference, so an agent using ECI could not inspect that evidence through the environmental capability view.
outcome.basis: The missing projection path was established by source inspection of the baseline commit. The diagnostic record and its stored reference are authentic session evidence; no historical ECI response was fabricated.
outcome.recurrence: One recorded diagnostic history entry in one campaign session; recurrence across sessions is not established.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Session diagnostic evidence was not discoverable through environmental capability analysis
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose bounded session diagnostic history summaries and validated same-session evidence references through the existing capability-intelligence projection, while preserving session context, response budgets, and limits on causal and agent-burden claims.

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence and Continuous Improvement Campaign

measurement_limits: The baseline omission is established by implementation-source inspection, not a captured pre-change ECI response.
The diagnostic summary is historical and belongs to one session; it does not establish current verification health or cross-session recurrence.
Agent receipt, intervention, time or tokens saved, root cause, and downstream service benefit were not measured.
